CFML Language Reference: Functions

ToBase64

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Returns the Base64 encoding of a string or a binary object. Base64 represents any data using only letters, digits, +, / and =, so it can travel safely in e-mail, cookies, form fields and database text columns.

Category

String functions

Syntax

ToBase64(string_or_binary)

Parameters

string_or_binary
A string, or a binary object (for example the result of CFFILE ACTION="ReadBinary").

Returns

The Base64-encoded string.

Usage

Use ToBinary to decode Base64 back into a binary object and ToString to turn that into text. Base64 is an encoding, not encryption: anybody can decode it. Encoded data is about a third larger than the original.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Plain = "Party like it's 1999!">
<CFSET Encoded = ToBase64(Plain)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>Plain text</TD><TD>#Plain# (#Len(Plain)# characters)</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ToBase64</TD><TD><TT>#Encoded#</TT> (#Len(Encoded)# characters)</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Round trip</TD><TD>#ToString(ToBinary(Encoded))#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ToBinary, ToString, IsBinary, Encrypt
